Fires reported in Noida residential building and Lucknow cold storage

Multiple fires were reported across India, including a significant blaze in a Noida residential high-rise and a cold storage unit in Lucknow. The Noida incident saw rescue operations and the deployment of fire tenders, with a suspected AC blast cited as the cause. No casualties were reported in the Noida fire. The Lucknow fire also involved multiple fire tenders battling the blaze.
